acceptanceCriteria: The owning spec carries a numbered adapter conformance checklist whose every item names the test or command that checks it.
The spec states three customization levels and which support level each can at most reach under the existing FULL/FALLBACK/UNSUPPORTED rule.
A third-party adapter can be exercised locally against the checklist without any host installed.
body: Owner requested this on 2026-09-22 after reviewing google/ax (Apache-2.0) as prior art; this ticket records an idea, not delivery or promotion. Original Go and doc work only; no source import. Prior art: docs/runner.md in https://github.com/google/ax states the runner contract as a table of what the control plane sets, a numbered list of what any conforming runner must do, a closing checklist, and three customization levels (extend the default image, embed the runner package, write a runner from scratch), with a local test recipe outside the cluster. Current state: docs/specs/agent-harness-integration-v0.md defines the transport-neutral harness event wire and the per-tuple FULL/FALLBACK/UNSUPPORTED support rule, and docs/EXTENSION-ECOSYSTEM.md ranks adapters, but there is no single conformance checklist a third party can run against a new host adapter, and no stated customization ladder (reuse the shipped plugin, embed the adapter package, write an adapter from scratch against the event wire). Add that checklist and ladder to the owning spec and the authoring kit under V1-0027, with the existing host_adapter tests as the executable conformance floor. Nothing here promotes any tuple to FULL; V1-0005 still governs the matrix.
title: adapter: replaceable host-adapter contract with a conformance checklist and three customization levels
